title: GitLoom: your GitHub, woven into a portfolio website

scenes.title: Hook
lines: What if your GitHub could build your portfolio website for you?
This is GitLoom. Every letter you type weaves a new row.

scenes.title: Load a profile
lines: Give it a username, and it reads the public repos, languages and activity, right in your browser. No sign-up, no server.
Here it is with the built-in demo profile.

scenes.title: Templates
lines: Then make it yours. Ten templates. Same data, a completely different look.

scenes.title: Colour and fonts
lines: Any accent colour, nine headline fonts,

scenes.title: Sections
lines: and drag the sections into exactly the order you want.

scenes.title: Phone
lines: Every template already has a phone layout.

scenes.title: Finished site
lines: And the site comes finished: a Ctrl+K quick menu, project search, and a clean PDF résumé from the same data.

scenes.title: Publish
lines: When it looks right, download one HTML file, and host it free on GitHub Pages.

scenes.title: Outro
lines: GitLoom. Vanilla JavaScript and the GitHub API, nothing else.
Try it with your own username. The link is in the post.
